info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Account Transaction-spec
info.description: The Account Transaction Management API enables businesses to facilitate monetary transactions related to specific customer accounts. Through this API, users can initiate and process transactions for designated accounts, ensuring accurate record-keeping and financial operations. Common use cases include e-commerce platforms, financial services, and accounting applications managing customer accounts. This API streamlines transaction workflows and supports real-time financial tracking, allowing businesses to enhance customer service and operational efficiency.

post.summary: Create a new transaction for a specific account.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new transaction associated with a specific account. It requires the account ID and transaction details in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new transaction for a specific account under a customer. Ensure all required fields are provided to successfully process the transaction.

amount.description: The amount of money to be transacted.

status.description: The current status of the transaction.

postedDate.description: The date when the transaction was posted.

transactionDate.description: The date when the transaction occurred.
